src: Railroad Commission of Texas, Production Data Query Dump (file PDQ_DSV.zip, share https://mft.rrc.texas.gov/link/1f5ddb8d-329a-4459-b7f8-177b4f5ee60d, listed at https://www.rrc.texas.gov/resource-center/research/data-sets-available-for-download/, extracted 20-OCT-26, production months 1993-01 to 2026-08). Tables OG_COUNTY_LEASE_CYCLE (per operator and month, summed over leases and counties; the operator on each lease-month row) checked against OG_OPERATOR_CYCLE. Named operators: those whose P-5 organization type is corporation, LLC or limited partnership, whatever their P-5 status (P-5 Organization file orf850.txt.gz, share https://mft.rrc.texas.gov/link/04652169-eed6-4396-9019-2e270e790f6c, 'A ' records: operator number, organization name, status letter, organization code A / H / B); the PDQ OPERATOR_NO is the same six-digit number. Individuals, sole proprietors, partnerships, trusts, joint ventures and other types are not listed (their volumes stay in the county and statewide totals). Columns name, status and type come from that file. Operators with o12 + g12 > 0, by oil descending, rows beyond the size budget dropped (smallest by oil + gas first). leases = distinct leases with production in the latest 12 months. producers = all operators with production in the latest 12 months, nameableShare = the share of statewide oil and gas the nameable ones hold. An operator's series follows the operator of record month by month, so a step up can be an acquisition, not drilling. oil = crude oil (OIL_PROD_VOL) + condensate (COND_PROD_VOL), barrels; gas = gas-well gas (GAS_PROD_VOL) + casinghead gas (CSGD_PROD_VOL), mcf; leases and gas wells both count as leases. Months end at 2026-01, the last month in which RRC statewide crude + condensate is at least 98% of EIA's Texas field production; later months in the dump are still being reported and are left out (statewide figures for them: series-production.json, partial).
